create_sse_server_transport: create an SseServerTransport instance with an endpoint URL for MCP SSE communication
build_sse_connection: build an SSE connection using connect_sse context manager to yield read and write streams for a FastAPI request
handle_client_post_message: handle a POST request with a session_id to validate and forward JSONRPC messages to the SSE session writer
validate_jsonrpc_message: validate incoming JSON payload as a JSONRPCMessage using Pydantic model validation from mcp.types
send_sse_stream_message: send messages through an SSE stream writer with event type and JSON-serialized message data
